name: GO Fest 2026 Sunday Raid Makeup
title: GO Fest 2026 Sunday Raid Makeup
description: UPDATE from Scopely: We previously announced a special GO Fest 2026: Global Sunday raid event in select regions. Upon further investigation, we have found that the impact of technical issues related to raids was more widespread than initially thought. Therefore, we will expand the event globally to include all Trainers. The event will take place on Sunday, July 26, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time. Additionally, we appreciate your extended patience as we work through these updates. As a token of our gratitude and sincere apology for the confusion we have caused, we have increased the number of free Raid Passes from 9 to 12 for this event. As compensation for a technical issue that prevented some Trainers from joining Raid Battles during Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global, a special Sunday raid makeup event will be held on July 26, 2026 from 10 am to 7 pm local time. Raid Bosses featured during the original Sunday of GO Fest 2026: Global—including Mega Mewtwo Y Super Mega Raids—will appear!
